evidence.baseline: The chapters that follow examine many things [mark] physiology, relationship, extraction, infrastructure, economics, governance, intelligence [mark] and they may not always appear to be about technology directly. They are.
evidence.shipped: The chapters that follow examine physiology, relationship, extraction, infrastructure, economics, governance, and intelligence. They may not always appear to be about technology directly. They are.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.10 applied to many things as vague reference.
findings.diagnosis: Many things is not vague. It sets up the concession, because the point of the sentence is that a reader looking at that list will not see a book about technology. Deleting it leaves the list doing the work of an inventory instead. The two-beat They may not always appear ... They are also depends on being the second half of one sentence and then a rebuttal; as three separate sentences the rebuttal answers a question nobody was shown asking.

findings.summary: The sentence explaining the book's method was split, and the method turned into a capability claim.

evidence.baseline: The book is making a sustained argument about what humane technology would have to become, and the argument can only be made by descending first into the conditions beneath technology and then climbing back up to ask what kind of technology those conditions can support.
evidence.shipped: The book makes a sustained argument about what humane technology would have to become. It can make that argument only by first descending into the conditions beneath technology, then climbing back up to ask what kind of technology those conditions can support.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.19, mechanical cadence, and R-TENSE read onto is making.
findings.diagnosis: The argument can only be made is a claim about the argument. It can make that argument only by is a claim about what the book is able to do, and it puts the book rather than the argument in the subject position at exactly the point where the page is explaining why the shape of the book is not arbitrary. R-CADENCE also applies directly: the baseline paragraph runs long, short, long, and the split makes it long, short, medium, medium, which is the flattening the rule was written to catch. R-TENSE does not authorize the change, because is making marks a process the reader is inside rather than a completed act.

findings.summary: The closing instruction to the reader was rewritten and its object changed.

evidence.baseline: The diagnostic chapters of Part I describe what that coherence currently lacks. Hold the technology question in the back of your mind as you read. The argument the chapters make ... is, finally, an argument about what kind of technology can be built ...
evidence.shipped: The diagnostic chapters of Part I describe the conditions currently missing for coherence. Hold the technology question in mind as you read. The argument these chapters make ... is, finally, about what kind of technology can be built ...

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.10 applied to that coherence.
findings.diagnosis: What that coherence currently lacks points back to the coherence the previous paragraph named, which is the referent 4.10 asks for. The conditions currently missing for coherence points at nothing and adds two abstractions. In the back of your mind is an instruction a reader can follow; in mind is not, because holding a question in mind while reading is just reading. And an argument about is the page's own vocabulary, since the sentence is drawing an equivalence between two arguments; dropping the noun leaves a copula joining an argument to a topic.

findings.summary: Two definite articles were dropped where the argument depends on their pointing.

evidence.baseline: better intentions applied to the current architectures ... Which means the work of building humane technology is also, and primarily, the work of building the coherence on which it would depend.
evidence.shipped: better intentions applied to current architectures ... This means the work of building humane technology is also, and primarily, the work of building the coherence on which it would depend.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.10 applied to Which.
findings.diagnosis: The current architectures are the specific ones Part I has just spent four chapters describing. Current architectures is a category. And Which means attaches an inference to the sentence that licenses it, which is what a connective fragment is for; This means detaches it and asks the reader to find the antecedent, which is the defect 4.10 describes rather than a repair of it. The same substitution was made in the Editor's Note, so it is a habit rather than a local judgment.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Three prohibited marks. One pair enclosed the seven-item list inside the opening sentence; a comma pair would have been unreadable against the list's own commas, so the syntax was rebuilt as a colon introducing the enumeration and a period before the concession, which now opens with And. One introduced the specification of what a different logic means and became a colon; the pass had already made that repair and it stands.
The pass's colon after operate by a different logic. It is the repair R-PUNCT-STRUCT prescribes for a mark introducing a specification.

Many things and the concession it sets up, the single cumulative sentence about the book's method, the two definite articles, the Which means fragment, and the closing instruction in its baseline wording including in the back of your mind and an argument about.

standardAudit.scope: Re-read against the immutable baseline under the full twenty-rule standard, with specific checks for the seven rules that postdate this record: R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, R-REFRAIN-COST, R-DEIXIS.

refrainAnchor.refrain: Each of the four TOWARD HUMANE TECHNOLOGY interstitials closes on an italic instruction that tells the reader how to read what follows or what was just read.
refrainAnchor.note: Anchored here at the first interstitial. Four instances in both texts, at manuscript lines 149, 343, 873, and 1023. The convention is the series' spine: each part transition re-aims the technology question before the register changes. The recurrence is deliberate and parallel by design, so catalog 4.9's retention limb applies to the set, and the single edit that would change every instance is the closing-instruction convention itself. Child audits cite this anchor rather than re-counting.

checks: R-DEIXIS: engaged by the original record as F3 and F4. Re-checked: the restored definite articles and the closing instruction, Hold the technology question in the back of your mind as you read, hold. No further instance.

R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: the committing beat They are. survives immediately after the concession that the chapters may not always appear to be about technology directly. The concession did not outlive its answer.

R-PAIRED-DELETION: the page's forward reference, the diagnostic chapters of Part I describe what that coherence currently lacks, has its paying end in Chapters One through Four, and the instruction to hold the technology question is redeemed by the later interstitials' returns. Both ends present in both texts.
R-CORRECTION-SCOPE and R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD: no recorded correction reaches this page and nothing was cut against an open canon query. CTD-0066's cadence obligation remains open and unruled.
R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT: the single kept, the colon after operate by a different logic, is R-PUNCT-STRUCT compliance. No uncredited improvement.
R-REFRAIN-COST: the interstitial closing-instruction refrain is anchored above.
standardAudit.result: The record's four findings hold under the twenty-rule standard. The audit adds the interstitial refrain anchor. No further prose change. Confirmed.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-02 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. This is a short orientation page and the losses are small, but they repeat the pattern the Prologue established. Twice the pass replaced a demonstrative or a definite article that pointed at material three paragraphs back with a generic form that points at nothing, and both times it did so under catalog 4.10, whose actual instruction is to name the referent. R-DEIXIS already covers the case and no extension is needed.
